title: How BJP Shapes Opinion with Propaganda
description:
Every election season in India brings a flood of promises, subsidies, and emotional appeals. But behind the noise lies a darker game — propaganda techniques and logical fallacies that manipulate voters.

In this documentary, Pale Blue Thoughts breaks down the most common propaganda tactics in Indian politics:

Agenda setting — like Mandir yahin banega and the Hindutva narrative.

Appeal to emotion — using fear and patriotism instead of policies.

Demonizing the enemy — strawman fallacies branding critics as deshdrohi or “anti-national.”

Demoralization — weakening opposition morale, from ED raids to Godi Media narratives.

The Big Lie — repeating falsehoods (like demonetisation, farm bills, and CAA “success”) until people believe them.

Disinformation — rewriting textbooks, renaming cities, and using WhatsApp University to distort history.

From farmers’ protests to CAA-NRC, from minority demonization to selective history rewriting, propaganda has become the default mode of politics. These tricks distract from real issues like jobs, healthcare, and education.

If you’ve searched for election propaganda India, BJP fallacies, political propaganda techniques, Indian politics debunked, or propaganda during elections, this video gives you the tools to spot the lies.
